instruction.name: xvpickve2gr.w
instruction.description: Pick the 32-bit element at lane `idx` from `a`, sign-extend it to the GPR width, and store it in `dst`.

experiments.name: round trip through the reverse move

latencies.notes: 1 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. Unroll 10000, iters 1000. Raw measurement was 5.99; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.
